name: a_earnings_next
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Earnings tonight & tomorrow.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 4:00 PM ET (after the close) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Companies reporting after the close on the brief date or before the open on the next session: EPS and revenue consensus, year-ago figures, options-implied move, and analyst previews (firm, rating, PT).

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **No major earnings reports** `[Calendar]`

- CNBC’s October 4 weekly calendar listed **no earnings reports of note for Monday, October 5, 2026**, after the close; the next scheduled reports were **RPM International (RPM), Lamb Weston (LW), and Apogee Enterprises (APOG) before the open Tuesday, October 6**, followed by **Constellation Brands (STZ), Worthington Steel (WS), and Penguin Solutions (PENG) after the close Tuesday**. (CNBC, Oct. 4, 2026; updated Oct. 5 09:31 ET)[1]
- A separate October 5 earnings calendar listed companies reporting on October 5 but did not identify a major US-equity report with the requested consensus and year-ago data before the 12:20 ET cutoff. (Benzinga, Oct. 5, 2026; updated 11:15 ET)[15]

## **LW** — Lamb Weston `[Retail / Food]`

- Lamb Weston was scheduled to report **fiscal Q1 2027 before the open Tuesday, October 6, 2026**, followed by a conference call at **09:00 ET**. (Business Wire, cited Oct. 4, 2026)[10]
- Consensus was **$0.584 EPS** and **$1.6541 billion revenue**, versus **$0.74 EPS** and **$1.66 billion revenue** in the year-ago quarter. (MarketBeat, cited Oct. 4, 2026)[10]
- The average analyst price target was **$52.91**; the consensus rating was **Hold**, based on **3 Buy** ratings and **11 Hold** ratings. (MarketBeat, cited Oct. 4, 2026)[10]
- JPMorgan maintained **Neutral** and cut its price target from **$52 to $46**. (ScanX, cited Oct. 4, 2026)[10]
- Fiscal 2027 EPS guidance was **$2.95–$3.25**. (Lamb Weston guidance, cited Oct. 4, 2026)[10]

## **STZ** — Constellation Brands `[Retail / Beverages]`

- Constellation Brands was scheduled to report **fiscal Q2 2027 after the close Tuesday, October 6, 2026**. (TradingView/Seeking Alpha, Oct. 4, 2026; updated Oct. 5 11:47 ET)[4]
- Consensus was **$3.55 EPS** and **$2.54 billion revenue**. (TradingView/Seeking Alpha, Oct. 4, 2026; updated Oct. 5 11:47 ET)[4]
- Constellation’s fiscal Q2 2026 year-ago figures were not specified in the retrieved October 2–5 sources. 
- In fiscal Q1 2027, Constellation reported **$3.43 EPS** versus **$3.27 consensus** and **$2.43 billion net sales** versus **$2.42 billion expected**. (TradingView/Seeking Alpha, Oct. 4, 2026; updated Oct. 5 11:47 ET)[4]
- Management previously raised **full-year fiscal 2027 GAAP EPS guidance** and maintained **comparable EPS guidance at $11.20–$11.90**. (TradingView/Seeking Alpha, Oct. 4, 2026; updated Oct. 5 11:47 ET)[4]

## **PEP** — PepsiCo `[Retail / Beverages]`

- PepsiCo was scheduled to report **fiscal Q3 2026 before the open Thursday, October 8, 2026**, outside the requested October 5–6 earnings window. (CMC Markets, Oct. 2, 2026; updated Oct. 2 18:51 ET)[7]
- Consensus was **$2.30 EPS** and approximately **$25.0 billion revenue**; the fiscal Q3 2025 year-ago EPS was approximately **$2.30**, and revenue was forecast to rise **4.3%**. (CMC Markets, Oct. 2, 2026; updated Oct. 2 18:51 ET)[7]
- The options market implied an approximately **4% move in either direction** around the report. (CMC Markets, Oct. 2, 2026; updated Oct. 2 18:51 ET)[7]
- JPMorgan had downgraded PepsiCo to **Neutral** and cut its price target to **$138**. (TradingView/Seeking Alpha, Oct. 4, 2026; updated Oct. 5 11:47 ET)[4]
